issues.description: getSourceMap runs synchronous readFileSync per stack frame with no caching
issues.detail: On every frame during error serialization, the code runs existsSync + readFileSync + parse on the same file. For an N-frame trace in one module that is N disk reads of a stable value. Memoize the source map by file path so a noisy test run does not turn every error into repeated blocking I/O.

issues.description: resolve(from, '..', s) changes path semantics with no precondition stated and no unit test
issues.detail: The fix flips from resolving sources against the map URL to resolving against the map's parent directory. That is the correct sourcemap-spec behavior, but DecodedMap is shared utility code with no documented precondition on `from` and no unit test in packages/utils. A snapshot in test/cli is the only evidence. Add a direct test and a one-line comment so this does not regress.

issues.description: Fallback returning '{}' as a source map silently masks broken sourcemap references
issues.detail: createConvertSourceMapReadMap returns the string '{}' when the referenced map file is missing, so convert-source-map parses an empty object and pretends success. A broken sourceMappingURL becomes indistinguishable from a missing one and downstream consumers receive a valid-looking empty map. Return undefined and let the caller decide, or log once at debug level.

issues.description: External-module discriminator `!mod?.transformResult` complects unrelated concerns and is undocumented
issues.detail: The heuristic intertwines module identity, Vite's transform state, and filesystem existence to mean 'external untransformed module.' If Vite ever populates transformResult for an externalized module, source maps are silently skipped. Extract an isExternalUntransformed(file) predicate and state the Vite invariant being relied on.

issues.description: readFileSync on the error-reporting path is not wrapped in try/catch
issues.detail: existsSync + readFileSync is racy and readFileSync can still throw (EACCES, EISDIR, symlink loop). If it throws inside the getSourceMap callback during parseErrorStacktrace, the user sees a sourcemap error instead of their original test failure. Wrap in try/catch and fall through to no source map.

issues.description: Mixing node:path with the existing pathe import, and inlining a Vite-forked extractor without an abstraction boundary
issues.detail: The file already imports resolve from 'pathe' but the new code reaches for node:path. Pick one voice. Separately, extractSourcemapFromFile is copied from Vite with only a commit-SHA comment, so the fork will drift silently when Vite evolves. Either import from Vite or name the divergence so future readers know this is a fork.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a real bug with a mostly correct fix, but the implementation is delivered without the rigor it needs. The DecodedMap resolve() change is the right sourcemap-spec behavior but lacks a documented precondition and a unit test in packages/utils. The new getSourceMap path in test-run.ts performs uncached synchronous I/O on every error frame, uses a fragile undocumented heuristic to detect external modules, and silently swallows missing-map files by returning a fake '{}'. Tighten the screws — memoize by file, add a try/catch, return undefined on missing maps, extract the externality predicate, and add a direct resolvedSources test — before landing.
